body.zh-Hant: 特奧多魯斯（特奧）·海姆斯克爾克1852年7月20日生於阿姆斯特丹，是保守派政治人物揚·海姆斯克爾克之子。他在萊頓大學攻讀羅馬法與現代法，1876年5月13日取得博士學位。
body.en: Theodorus (Theo) Heemskerk was born in Amsterdam on 20 July 1852, the son of the conservative politician Jan Heemskerk. He studied Roman and contemporary law at Leiden and took his doctorate on 13 May 1876.

citations.quote: Amsterdam, 20 juli 1852
dateOfBirth: 1852-07-20
Zoon van Jan Heemskerk, conservatief politicus
Romeins en hedendaags recht (gepromoveerd op dissertatie), Hogeschool te Leiden
op 13 mei 1876 zijn promotie volgt tot doctor in het Romeins en hedendaags recht

heading.zh-Hant: 律師、議員與阿姆斯特丹市參事

body.zh-Hant: 他自1876年起在阿姆斯特丹執業為律師，至1901年5月。1888年5月1日起他進入第二院（眾議院）；1901年5月15日起出任阿姆斯特丹市參事，至1908年2月12日。1901年有人請他入閣，他因個人理由推辭；1903年他當選反革命黨議員團主席。
body.en: He practised as an advocate in Amsterdam from 1876 until May 1901. He entered the Tweede Kamer on 1 May 1888 and from 15 May 1901 to 12 February 1908 was an Amsterdam alderman. In 1901 he was asked to take a ministerial post and declined for personal reasons; in 1903 he became chairman of the Anti-Revolutionary parliamentary club.

body.zh-Hant: 1907年12月30日他受命組織新內閣，但實際的組閣工作到1908年1月16日才展開；他自1月16日至2月11日擔任組閣人。據來源，他經長時間猶豫才接受任務，兩週後就向女王提出內閣名單。庫佩爾覺得自己被繞過，海姆斯克爾克是違背庫佩爾的意思才成為內閣領導人，兩人因而起衝突。
body.en: On 30 December 1907 he was charged with forming a cabinet, though his formation work only began on 16 January 1908; he served as cabinet formateur from 16 January to 11 February 1908. He accepted the task after long hesitation and within two weeks could present the new ministry to the queen. Kuyper felt passed over, and Heemskerk became cabinet leader against Kuyper's wishes, leading to a conflict.

citations.quote: Kreeg op 30 december 1907 de opdracht een kabinet te vormen
kabinetsformateur, van 16 januari 1908 tot 11 februari 1908
De opdracht wordt door Heemskerk na lange aarzeling aanvaard.
Na twee weken kan hij het nieuwe ministerie reeds aan de vorstin voordragen.
Kuyper, terug in Nederland, voelt zich gepasseerd
werd in 1908 tegen diens zin kabinetsleider, hetgeen leidde tot een conflict

heading.zh-Hant: 內閣領導人與內政大臣
heading.en: Prime minister and Minister of the Interior

body.zh-Hant: 1908年2月12日起他任內政大臣，並於2月13日起擔任部長會議主席，至1913年8月29日；他並在1908年2月12日至5月18日兼任殖民大臣（代理）。1908年他完成法定時間的引入，採用阿姆斯特丹時間；1910年他設立修憲國家委員會並親任主席。1913年選舉失敗後，內閣下台。
body.en: From 12 February 1908 he was Minister of the Interior and from 13 February chairman of the Council of Ministers, until 29 August 1913; he was also acting Minister of the Colonies from 12 February to 18 May 1908. In 1908 he brought in statutory time, with Amsterdam time chosen, and in 1910 he set up a State Commission on constitutional revision and chaired it himself. After the 1913 election defeat the ministry resigned.

heading.zh-Hant: 國務委員會與司法大臣
heading.en: Council of State and Minister of Justice

body.zh-Hant: 1913年10月1日他轉任國務委員會委員，至1918年9月9日。1918年他第二度入閣，這次擔任司法大臣，至1925年8月4日。據來源，他任內通過的法律包括1923年的拒服兵役法與1924年的海商法修訂。
body.en: On 1 October 1913 he became a member of the Council of State, serving until 9 September 1918. In 1918 he entered cabinet a second time, now as Minister of Justice, until 4 August 1925. Among the laws passed under him were the 1923 conscientious-objection act and the 1924 revision of maritime law.

citations.quote: lid Raad van State, van 1 oktober 1913 tot 9 september 1918
minister van Justitie, van 9 september 1918 tot 4 augustus 1925
In 1918 volgt dan een tweede ministerschap, nu aan Justitie
Bracht in 1923 samen met minister Van Dijk de Dienstweigeringswet tot stand
een herziening van het zeerecht (1924)

body.zh-Hant: 1925年9月15日他重返第二院，至1932年6月12日。他自1925年9月16日起任反革命黨議員團主席，1929年被科萊恩（Colijn）接替，隨後改任副主席。1926年8月27日他獲任國務部長（Minister van Staat）。他於1932年6月12日在烏特勒支病逝。
body.en: He returned to the Tweede Kamer on 15 September 1925 and sat until 12 June 1932. He chaired the ARP parliamentary party from 16 September 1925 until Colijn replaced him in 1929, after which he was vice-chairman. On 27 August 1926 he was named Minister of State. He died in Utrecht on 12 June 1932.

heading.en: Life dates and election to the Althing

body.zh-Hant: 約恩·馬格努松生於1859年，卒於1926年，是冰島政治人物與法律人（jurist）；他1902年當選阿爾庭（冰島議會）議員。丹麥人物辭典說，他在議會中的立場與哈納斯·哈夫斯坦及自治黨（hjemmestyrepartiet）一致。
body.en: Jón Magnússon was born in 1859 and died in 1926, an Icelandic politician and jurist. He was elected to the Althing in 1902. The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon says he aligned himself in the Althing with Hannes Hafstein and the home-rule party.

citations.quote: Jón Magnússon, 1859-1926, islandsk politiker og jurist.
Magnússon blev valgt til Altinget i 1902
hvor han stillede sig på linje med Hannes Hafstein og hjemmestyrepartiet

body.zh-Hant: 據丹麥人物辭典，他生於1859年1月16日，出生地是冰島北部的穆利（Múli）牧師住所。他1881年畢業於雷克雅維克的拉丁學校，1891年取得哥本哈根大學法學學位。
body.en: According to the Dansk Biografisk Leksikon he was born on 16 January 1859 at the parsonage of Múli in northern Iceland. He finished the Reykjavik Latin school in 1881 and took his law degree at the University of Copenhagen in 1891.

citations.quote: Født på præstegården Múli i Nordisland
student fra Reykjaviks lærde skole 1881 og cand.jur. 1891 fra Kbh.s univ.

body.zh-Hant: 同一辭典載，他畢業後先任西人島（Vestmannaeyjar）的郡長（sysselmand），1896年任土地總督（landshøvding）的辦事員（fuldmægtig）。1904年冰島部在雷克雅維克設立時，他成為部門主管（departementschef），1908年任市法官（byfoged）。
body.en: The same dictionary says that after graduating he became sysselmand on the Westman Islands, in 1896 a clerk (fuldmægtig) to the landshøvding, head of department (departementschef) when the Icelandic ministry was created in Reykjavik in 1904, and in 1908 town judge (byfoged).

citations.quote: Han blev derefter sysselmand på Vestmannaøerne
1896 fuldmægtig hos landshøvdingen
Ved oprettelsen 1904 af det islandske ministerium i Reykjavik
blev han departementschef og 1908 byfoged

body.zh-Hant: 1908年，他是提出丹麥與冰島關係方案的委員會成員；該方案後來未獲阿爾庭通過。
body.en: In 1908 he sat on the committee that put forward a proposal on the relationship between Denmark and Iceland; it was not approved by the Althing.

citations.quote: Magnússon sad i 1908 i det udvalg
som fremsatte et forslag om forbindelsen mellem Danmark og Island
det blev dog ikke godkendt i Altinget

heading.en: Act of Union and first premiership

body.zh-Hant: 丹麥人物辭典說，第一次世界大戰期間他參加了丹麥與冰島《聯盟法》的談判。該法於1918年12月1日生效後，他成為冰島第一任總理；這一職位他任到1922年，1924至1926年又再任。
body.en: The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon says that during the First World War he took part in the negotiations on the Danish-Icelandic Act of Union. After the Act came into force on 1 December 1918 he became Iceland's first prime minister, a post he held until 1922 and again in 1924-26.

citations.quote: Under første verdenskrig
deltog i forhandlingerne om den dansk-islandske forbundslov
forbundslovens ikrafttræden 1.12.1918
blev han Islands første statsminister
en post han besad til 1922 og igen 1924-26

body.zh-Hant: 冰島政府官網記載，他第一屆內閣自1917年1月4日至1920年2月25日，第二屆自1920年2月25日至1922年3月7日；兩屆內閣中他都兼任總理（forsætisráðherra）與司法大臣（dómsmálaráðherra）。1917年的財政大臣先為比約恩·克里斯強松，8月28日起換為西古德·埃格爾茨。丹麥大百科稱，1918年《聯盟法》使冰島成為與丹麥共主聯合的獨立國家，那是他任總理期間。
body.en: Iceland's government website dates his first ministry from 4 January 1917 to 25 February 1920 and his second from 25 February 1920 to 7 March 1922; in both he was prime minister and minister of justice. In 1917 the finance minister was first Björn Kristjánsson and from 28 August Sigurður Eggerz. Den Store Danske says that Iceland became an independent state in personal union with Denmark under the 1918 Act of Union during his time as prime minister.

body.zh-Hant: 1924年3月22日起他第三度組閣。丹麥大百科記他1924至1926年這一屆由保守黨（Íhaldsflokkur）提名。冰島政府官網記載，他在這屆內閣中兼任總理與司法大臣，並於1926年6月23日去世；同日起由馬格努斯·古德蒙松接任總理。丹麥人物辭典補充，他在東冰島旅行途中去世，葬於雷克雅維克。
body.en: From 22 March 1924 he formed his third ministry. Den Store Danske records that in 1924-26 he was put forward by the Conservative Party (Íhaldsflokkur). Iceland's government website lists him as prime minister and minister of justice in this ministry, notes that he died on 23 June 1926, and shows Magnús Guðmundsson as prime minister from that day. The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon adds that he died on a journey in eastern Iceland and was buried in Reykjavik.

body.en: Andrey Lyapchev was born in Resen on 30 November 1866 and died in Sofia on 6 November 1933. The German National Library authority record classes him as a Bulgarian politician and head of government (Regierungschef).

heading.en: The Tsankov cabinet and the 1926 formation

body.zh-Hant: 義大利百科全書指出，贊科夫（Cankov）在1923年6月任內閣首長，1926年被迫辭職。保加利亞科學院歷史研究所期刊上的一篇論文，論述贊科夫內閣通過1923年6月9日的軍事政變上台，並把利亞普切夫列為「民主協定」（Democratic Agreement）黨領導人之一；論文標題記他的內閣於1926年1月4日組成。
body.en: The Enciclopedia Italiana says that Cankov (Tsankov) headed the government from June 1923 and had to resign in 1926. An article in a Bulgarian Academy of Sciences history journal says the Tsankov cabinet came to power through the military coup of 9 June 1923 and names Liapchev among the leaders of the Democratic Agreement; its title dates the formation of his government to 4 January 1926.

body.zh-Hant: 據義大利百科全書，贊科夫之後由利亞普切夫（Andrea Ljapčev）接任，他掌權到1931年，接著是穆沙諾夫（Nicola Mušanov）至1934年；該書稱兩人都是民主黨人（democratici）。
body.en: According to the Enciclopedia Italiana, Cankov was succeeded by Ljapčev, who stayed in power until 1931, and then by Nikola Mušanov until 1934; the encyclopedia calls both of them Democrats.

citations.quote: Gli successero Andrea Ljapčev, che restò al potere fino al 1931
e Nicola Mušanov, che vi restò fino al 1934, ambedue democratici.
